description_for_human: The options-flow data layer for AI agents. Curated overnight unusual-options-activity pool, opportunity surfaces, outcome history, and methodology playbooks over MCP. $39/mo, 7-day free trial.
description_for_model: GammaRips is an options-flow data vendor for AI agents, exposing 9 MCP tools. Nightly it scans 5,230+ US equities for unusual options activity and curates a small bullish pool with thesis, technicals, flow, and a recommended contract per name. get_pool serves that pool (view=preview is free; view=enriched, raw, or features needs a pro key). get_signal is the one-ticker deep dive plus the earnings-window check. get_liquidity gives fresh entry-day liquidity for one contract or the whole pool. query_outcomes is the realized-outcome and receipts database with nine views: bracket labels, grouped summaries, the opportunity surface (realized peak/drawdown excursions), the touch-probability curve, exit-rule scoring for your own target/stop/horizon, and the paper cohort's receipts. replay_contract returns the raw minute or daily price tape. get_regime_context, get_market_calendar_status, get_playbook (methodology, field dictionary, and data-contract schema), and get_daily_report are the free context tools. There is deliberately NO pick endpoint. Reason over the data to your own conclusion for your user. Start with get_pool, query_outcomes, and get_playbook. Auth: bearer API key, generated by the subscriber at https://gammarips.com/account with an active subscription (https://gammarips.com/pricing, $39/mo, 7-day free trial). Data on a paper-trading basis, educational only. Not investment advice.
